source_name: 科利瓦金-格罗斯-扎吉尔定理
canonical_statement: For an elliptic curve E over Q, if its Hasse-Weil L-function has order of vanishing at s = 1 at most one, then the Mordell-Weil rank of E(Q) equals that order of vanishing and the Tate-Shafarevich group of E is finite.

conclusion: rank_Z E(Q) = ord_(s=1) L(E,s), and Sha(E/Q) is finite
